RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the April 25, 2008/V aisakha 5, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
146
Proposal to take over Nilachal Ispat
Nigam Ltd.
*461. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Steel Authority of India
is proposing to take over the Nilachal Ispat
Nigam Ltd., Dhubri, Orissa which was a
joint venture of MMTC and the
Government of Orissa; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Non-payment of dues of hospitals
empanelled under CGHS by
Government
*462. SHRI DARA SINGH:
SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
on account of non-payment, many
hospitals in the capital are either refusing
to be empanelled under Central
Government Health Scheme or telling
patients to pay upfront;
(b) whether it is a fact that CGHS owes
Rs. 17,66,953 to AIIMS, Rs. 7 crore to
Indraprastha Apollo Hospital, Rs. 3.5 crore
to Max Healthcare, etc.;
(c) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
and
(d) by when Government is expected
to clear all such dues so that CGHS
beneficiaries may not be put to any further
hardships?
Research contracts
*463. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry awards
research contracts to Consultants, NGOs,
Academic and Research Organisations, etc.;
(b) if so, the list of research contracts
with the name of the organisations which
were awarded the research contracts in the
last three years and their progress;
(c) whether the research contracts are
displayed on the website of his Ministry
and if not, the reasons therefor;

147
(d) the internal process in deciding the
topics of these research contracts;
(e) whether the research contracts were
awarded through a competitive bidding
process; and
(f) if so, the criteria adopted therefor
and if not, the sanctity of the award
process?
Delay in setting up of new AIIMS like
institutions
†*464. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the reasons for delay
in setting up new institutions on the lines
of All India Institute of Medical Sciences;
(b) the details of projects undertaken,
so far, institution-wise;
(c) the details of funds allocated to each
institution during the last five years, along
with the amounts spent out of it; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government for early setting up of these
institutions?
Need for review of Pulse Polio
Programme
*465. DR. K. KESHAV A RAO: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Pulse
Polio Programme needs a review in view of
the cases reported in the first two months
of the year 2008;
(b) if so, the details of the cases reported
in States; and
(c) what concrete action Government is
taking to fulfil its promise of total
eradication of polio?
Non-payment of outstanding amount
to sugarcane farmers
†*466. SHRI VEER PAL SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
farmers of Uttar Pradesh are not getting
proper price of sugarcane;
(b) the reasons why farmers are not
getting previous outstanding amount of
sugarcane;
(c) whether the Central Government is
taking any concrete measures in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof and by when
such measures would be taken; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
CBI inquiry into case of M/s Dow
Chemicals
*467. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to  refer to answer to Starred
Question 423 given in the Rajya Sabha on
4th May, 2007 and state:
(a) whether CBI inquiry into the case
of bribing of incumbent officials in the
Central Insecticide Board and in various
States' inspectorates by M/s Dow
Chemicals of USA for obtaining approval
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

148
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
for production/marketing of their several
inadmissible products in India has since
been completed;
(b) if so, the outcome thereof;
(c) whether steps have been taken for
debarring M/s Dow Chemicals from
producing/marketing their products in India
in deference to the demands made in Rajya
Sabha on 4th May, 2007;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Categories for steel consumers
†*468. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that steel
consumers in the country have been divided
into various categories for purchasing steel;
(b) if so, the details of such categories
along with the identified consumers in each
category;
(c) the average annual quantity of steel
out of total production sold to consumers
of each category during the last four years;
and
(d) to what extent the quantity sold is
less than the demand of the consumers of
each category?
Buffer stock for emergency situations
*469. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
form a strategic reserve of five million
tonnes of foodgrains in addition to the
buffer stock to meet emergency situations;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether to maintain strategic
reserves of foodgrains, adequate
warehouses/godowns exist;
(d) if so, the capacity of such
warehouses/godowns and whether new
warehouses/godowns would be set up to
maintain reserves of foodgrains; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
MDR-TB patients in the country
*470. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that daily 4400
TB patients die and number of MDR-TB
patients is increasing in the country;
(b) if so, Government's response thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that around
20 per cent of TB patients, who are
presently having TB, are actually availing
re-treatment after having failed to comply
with treatment regimens earlier; and
(d) if so, the details of steps taken or
proposed to be taken by Government to
tackle this deadly disease?
Janani Suraksha Yojana
*471. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
proper utilization of Janani Suraksha Yojana
(JSY) is not taking place because of
difficulties in comprehending the guidelines;

149
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Report of Quality Council of India on
pathological laboratories
*472. DR. K. MALAISAMY:
SHRI S. ANBALAGAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the core point in the report
of Quality Council of India with special
reference to pathological laboratories which
are considered to be the backbone of medical
profession;
(b) whether it is a fact that out of 25
lakh tests conducted every day, only one
lakh are carried out in accredited
laboratories and out of one lakh laboratories
in India, only 100 are accredited by
National Accredition Board for Testing and
Calibration Laboratories (NABL);
(c) the measures taken or being taken to
set right this alarming situation; and
(d) the time-frame within which it can
be done?
Death of children due to pneumonia
†*473. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of children who die due
to pneumonia each year in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the reasons for high rate of child
mortality due to this disease, in some
States; and
(c) whether Government will
contemplate certain steps to prevent this
disease by preparing an action plan in those
States where the child mortality rate is
comparatively higher than in the other
States?
Sale of milk not containing vitamin
'A'
†*474. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken
cognizance of the fact that toned milk
does not contain vitamin 'A' due to which
the children are falling victim to the
diseases caused by the deficiency of
vitamin 'A';
(b) the steps taken by Government to
ensure the sale of milk containing vitamin
'A' throughout the country; and
(c) by when legal obligation would be
imposed in this direction?
New medical, dental and nursing
colleges in the country
*475. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) how many medical colleges, dental
colleges and nursing colleges were opened
by the Government of India during the last
three years along with the locations thereof;
and
(b) the names of States which do not
have medical colleges in the country and

150
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
the steps taken by the Government of India
to impart medical education to the aspiring
students of those States?
Pesticides in bottled water
†*476. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has taken a
serious view on presence of pesticides in
bottled water of various brands;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Indian Standard Bureau
proposes to change the norms for testing
in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Non-completion of railway signalling
plans
†*477. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the reason
for non-completion of Railways’ signalling
plans is either due to the non-availability
of agencies or the non-availability of
equipments; and
(b) if so, the plan being formulated by
Government to complete it?
Bio-fuel plantation
*478. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to bring 12 million hectares of
land under bio-fuel crops;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) what type of land is proposed to be
used for bio-fuel plantations; and
(d) whether this step would have an
adverse impact on India's food security and
environment?
Shortage of manpower in healthcare
sector
*479. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the country is facing an
acute shortage of manpower in the
healthcare sector and most of the physicians
are migrating to developed countries like
Britain and US;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has formulated
any strategy to meet the demand for doctors
in the country's healthcare sector and to
check the brain drain; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

151
Breast cancer
†*480. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has assessed
the number of women who die every year
due to breast cancer in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether most of the hospitals/
primary healthcare centres in the country
are not properly detecting breast cancer
cases at the first stage;
(d) if so, whether the breast cancer
awareness programmes are also not
reaching the poor and rural women; and
(e) if so, the strategies to be adopted to
make hospitals/health centres equipped to
handle such cases?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 19th April, 2008 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 30, 1930 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Agriculture : 467, 474, 478,
Chemicals and Fertilizers :—
Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution : 466, 469, 476,
Health and Family Welfare : 462, 463, 464, 465, 470, 471, 472, 473,
475, 479, 480,
Micro, Small and Medium
Enterprises :—
Railways : 477,
Steel : 461, 468.
152
MGIPMRND—1577RS—19.04.2008.
